About 90% of ethanol plants have dry fractionation technology at the front end of their plant to extract nonedible corn oil at a rate of about 0.9 pounds per bushel, which is used as a feedstock for biodiesel/renewable diesel plants or in animal feed (RFA 2025b). Figure 30 shows 2024 corn oil production of 2.3 million tons and carbon capture of 2.7 million tons (RFA 2025d). Thirty percent of dry-mill ethanol plants capture carbon dioxide—those closer to cities sell carbon dioxide for use in pharmaceutical and food products (RFA 2025b).
